description: Offer a copy of a backup to another space. The copy holds the backup's whole disk, so confirm the destination space with the user first. Nothing is copied until the destination accepts (its owner, or a member there with Manage Backups) within 48 hours; the accepted copy is the destination's own and is billed to it, and this space's backup and bill are unchanged. Always a pending request through the API, even when the user owns both spaces. Needs the Manage Backups permission.

destinationSpaceId.description: The space to offer a copy to.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.

name: share_backup
title: Share Backup
